name: Katilimevim Tasarruf Finansman A.s.
summary: Katilimevim Tasarruf Finansman Anonim Sirketi provides interest-free and maturity-free car financing in Türkiye. It also engages in the rental and management of shopping malls and commercial properties. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Istanbul, Türkiye.
